## Description
What problem does this solve, and what behavior should result?

## Scope
What changes belong in this issue? Link the product requirements and milestone plan.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Describe an observable result and the evidence needed to accept it.

## Dependencies
Link prerequisite issues, or write None. Link the parent milestone tracker.

## Verification
List the relevant local tests, manual observations, or artifact checks. Distinguish
measured results from unknowns. CI remains manual during development.

## Completion evidence
Add implementation commit links, actual check results and remaining limitations
before closing the issue.
